column1: # Polish diacritic-fold table (D-436) - base letter -> every real accented variant, so a token typed
# without its diacritic ("zolty") still reaches the correctly-spelled word ("żółty"), both live while typing
# and at autocorrect/split-repair time. hints.tsv (same folder) picks one representative symbol per key for
# the AltGr long-press hint; this file keeps the complete set per base letter - z hosts two real variants
# (ź and ż, both genuine distinct Polish letters, not alternate spellings of each other).
